sapPrerequisites.title: Company Code
sapPrerequisites.description: Core organizational entity and posting control must be active before automated service invoice handling.

sapPrerequisites.title: Vendor Master
sapPrerequisites.description: Vendor account must be complete and compliant for service PO invoice matching and posting.

sapPrerequisites.title: Service Master
sapPrerequisites.description: Service definitions are required to interpret service line semantics and valuation correctly.

sapPrerequisites.title: Account Assignment
sapPrerequisites.description: Financial assignment objects ensure extracted services post to valid controlling structures.

sapPrerequisites.title: Tax Codes
sapPrerequisites.description: Tax determination must be configured for service procurement and regulatory compliance.

sapPrerequisites.title: PO Configuration for Services
sapPrerequisites.description: Service-specific PO behavior is required for extraction and three-way match logic.

bcPrerequisites.title: Company Setup
bcPrerequisites.description: Business Central company context, accounting periods, and base posting controls must be configured.

bcPrerequisites.title: Vendor Card
bcPrerequisites.description: Vendor profile must be complete and unblocked for compliant automation.

bcPrerequisites.title: Resources
bcPrerequisites.description: Service resources and costing attributes are required for line-level service interpretation.

bcPrerequisites.title: Dimensions & Projects
bcPrerequisites.description: Dimension governance and project controls must align with invoice account assignments.

bcPrerequisites.title: Tax/VAT Setup
bcPrerequisites.description: VAT calculation and posting groups must support policy-compliant invoice posting.

bcPrerequisites.title: Purchases & Payables Setup
bcPrerequisites.description: Purchasing document behavior, approvals, and posting defaults must be prepared for service flows.
